actions.action: Watch YouTube videos on how to prune money trees
Prune the tree, cutting 1 inch above a node
Move the plant to a spot with more light, such as a north-facing window
Once growth starts, fertilize monthly with half-strength liquid fertilizer from March to October
Check whether the rootball is more than 2 inches bigger than the pot
If root-bound, repot into a clay or nursery pot 2 inches bigger
Check soil moisture with a pencil before watering
Use Fox Farm soil amended with perlite and orchid bark for drainage

verdict.reason: The answer never identifies multiple tangled money trees or suggests separating them, offering only generic pruning, light, fertilizing, watering and soil tips that are unlikely to worsen the plant.
